info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-Replace Pharmacy Prescriptions Transfer-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Transfer API facilitates the secure modification and transfer of patient prescriptions between pharmacy locations. This endpoint allows authorized pharmacies to update existing prescription records, ensuring that accurate and up-to-date information is available for patient care. Typical consumers include pharmacy management systems and pharmacy technicians who manage patient prescriptions. This API streamlines the process of prescription transfers, enhancing operational efficiency and improving service delivery in the pharmaceutical sector.

put.summary: Transfer a prescription to another pharmacy.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to transfer an existing prescription to a different pharmacy. The request must include the necessary prescription details and the new pharmacy's information.

requestBody.description: Request body for transferring prescriptions. This request allows the client to send information required for the transfer process. The payload must adhere to the specified JSON schema to ensure the transfer request is properly formatted.
